desc: QCD restart bandits on URB. paper/BASELINES.md B7 (change point, drift
unobserved) -- the class had no URB arm before this one.
Source: Gerogiannis, Huang & Veeravalli, arXiv:2410.13772.
Host block == iql/config1.json.
arm = glr   Bernoulli-GLR detection + restart, the paper's recommendation.
'rr' is their order-optimal random-restart control (Theorem 11) and
'master' reproduces MASTER's two tests so the negative result of their
Theorem 4 can be checked here.
delta = null -> 1/sqrt(T), the convention for an unknown change count.
alpha = null -> sqrt(log T / T), GLRklUCB's forced-exploration rate with
the number of change points taken as 1.
min_hist = 20   the detector needs a history before a split point means
anything; below this the GLR statistic is dominated by its own noise.
max_hist = 500  a sliding window on the per-route history. A restart
algorithm flushes anyway, so the window only bounds cost.
xi = 0.5    eta = T^-xi for the RR arm, the middle of the range their
experiments sweep (xi in 0.3 .. 0.8).
calib = 30   the reference (mean, sd) for that standardisation is measured
over the first 30 days and then FROZEN until the agent restarts. A
RUNNING reference absorbs the shift it is meant to detect: gate QCDR-2
measures 15.5 (below threshold, never fires) against 59.6 (fires) for
the same 300-second level change.
normalize_stream = true   the reward is standardised and squashed into
(0,1) before the Bernoulli GLR sees it. URB pays -1000 and a Bernoulli
KL is defined on [0,1]; raw, every value clips to the same boundary,
the statistic is identically zero and the detector can NEVER fire.
Setting this false reproduces that. See the module docstring.
